Both are relevant because Thomas Flynn may have died anywhere in the 1885–1895 window, and together they hold 33 scanned pages that could contain his will. The image lists for both volumes are now in hand, and no individual pages have been read yet.

The next step is to read the pages one by one using the transcription tool, starting with the earlier volume, to search for Thomas Flynn's will entry; when found, the image can go straight to extraction to pull out the facts and add it as a source.
